caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden confessional booth situated on a rectangular wooden platform. The structure has a high back, sides, and a front panel, all vertically oriented and rectangular in shape, with each side containing inset rectangular panels. The wood is illustrated in shades of light to medium brown, creating a realistic texture with visible grain patterns. The confessional features a decorative top edge with symmetrical scalloped ornamentation and two side supports with curved edges extending downward. There are two rectangular mesh or grille openings, one on the front-facing door and one on the right side of the booth. The confessional is drawn with precise lines and labeled shadows, giving it a three-dimensional appearance on a plain, light-colored background. In the lower right corner, the name "Edith Skinner" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Confessional
